entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling because I'd like to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh no, it works fine. To be honest, I just `changed my mind` about it. It was a bit of an `impulse buy` for a New Year's goal, and I find I just `don't use it` enough to justify keeping it. I was about to look into the VeloFit `resale` program, but thought I should check with you first.
I completely understand. Thanks for clarifying that for me. Let me just double-check the return eligibility on your account.
Alright, I've got good news. It looks like your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window, so we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, that's fantastic! I wasn't sure if I had missed the deadline. That's a relief.

Not at all. I see you're a VIP member with us, so I've gone ahead and processed the return approval. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Perfect. So I just print that out and ship the band back?

Exactly. Just place the item back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
That's great, Charlie. You've made this very easy. I appreciate your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
